columns.name: park_zone
columns.reason: Static geographic zone of the turbine within the park, fixed long before prediction.

columns.name: site_id
columns.reason: Immutable site identifier known from the asset register.

columns.name: commission_quarter
columns.reason: Historical commissioning date, fixed at installation.

columns.name: grid_node
columns.reason: Static electrical connection point recorded at build.

columns.name: operating_hours
columns.reason: Cumulative run-hours counter readable at prediction time.

columns.name: met_mast_id
columns.reason: Static reference met mast assigned to the site.

columns.name: spare_depot
columns.reason: Standing logistics assignment of which depot serves the site.

columns.name: vessel_class
columns.reason: Reads as the site's contracted access vessel class rather than a swap-specific vessel.

columns.name: oem_campaign
columns.reason: Fleet-level OEM service campaign designation published ahead of any repair.

columns.name: insurer
columns.reason: Standing insurance relationship on the asset.

columns.name: endoscopy_pitting_grade
columns.reason: Latest borescope inspection grade is condition-monitoring evidence recorded before the replacement decision.

columns.name: filter_spec
columns.reason: Installed oil filter specification, a static component attribute.

columns.name: blade_vendor
columns.reason: As-built supplier attribute fixed at manufacture.

columns.name: capacity_factor
columns.reason: Production ratio computable from history up to prediction time.

columns.name: bearing_lot
columns.reason: Manufacturing lot of the installed bearing, known from build records.

columns.name: controller_ver
columns.reason: Currently deployed firmware version is known at prediction time.

columns.name: turbulence_index
columns.reason: Site wind-regime metric derived from met data already collected.

columns.name: sector_management
columns.reason: Operating strategy setting configured in advance.

columns.name: warranty_class
columns.reason: Contractual classification in force before any repair.

columns.name: scada_temp_trend
columns.reason: Temperature trend from SCADA history up to the prediction moment.

columns.name: access_class
columns.reason: Static accessibility category of the turbine location.

columns.name: foundation_type
columns.reason: Fixed structural attribute set at installation.

columns.name: icing_package
columns.reason: Installed option package known from asset configuration.

columns.name: noise_mode
columns.reason: Configured operating mode known before prediction.

columns.name: crane_mobilisation_usd
columns.reason: Cost is incurred to mobilise the crane for the swap, so it only exists once the replacement job happens.

columns.name: lightning_zone
columns.reason: Static site hazard classification.

columns.name: yaw_error_mean
columns.reason: SCADA-derived statistic computable from data already logged.

columns.name: port_of_entry
columns.reason: Standing logistics routing attribute for the site.

columns.name: tower_type
columns.reason: Fixed structural attribute of the turbine.

columns.name: curtailment_regime
columns.reason: Grid/operational regime assigned in advance of the prediction.

columns.name: turbine_model
columns.reason: Fixed asset model designation.

columns.name: converter_model
columns.reason: Installed component model recorded in the asset register.

columns.name: service_contract
columns.reason: Contract type in force before any maintenance event.

columns.name: post_swap_vibration_rms
columns.reason: Measured after the gearbox swap, so it exists only once the replacement has occurred.

columns.name: lube_brand
columns.reason: Lubricant brand currently in service is a known configuration fact.

columns.name: downtime_days
columns.reason: Downtime accrues from the failure and repair itself and is not final at prediction time.

columns.name: pitch_system
columns.reason: Installed subsystem type, fixed at build.

columns.name: gearbox_vendor
columns.reason: Vendor of the gearbox currently installed, known from build records.

columns.name: transformer_class
columns.reason: Installed component class recorded in asset data.

columns.name: crew_region
columns.reason: Standing service-organisation region covering the site.

columns.name: oil_iron_ppm_band
columns.reason: Banded result of the latest routine oil sample, recorded before any replacement.
